kind: B10 photo confirmation fixture diagnosis and isolation

cause.observed: Both requests posted the intended wall times with one WallTime marker and no original-instant override. Responses retained the exact resolved UTC instants and returned only a startsAt validation error.
cause.sourceInference: The service-hours branch is the only applicable startsAt-only validation after those normalized instants. Invalid date/range validation reports both endpoints, while resource exclusion reports a transition/conflict. The date parser and mobile paint are not implicated by the captured request.
cause.fixtureCollision: B11 syntheticServiceFixture approves an empty operating policy, projecting unknown_calendar_v1. B10 and S4 inserted global known calendars backdated by one second. Parallel fixture journeys could replace the current calendar, and backdating could leave a preceding unknown projection newer.
cause.identity: B10 seeds create a fresh staff principal UUID and property for each journey; Test Staff is a shared display name, not a shared broker identity. Production host/property overlap controls remain intact.
cause.limit: The exact selected policy row ID was not in the safe action response and the disposable browser database was already cleaned. Calendar-gate attribution follows the captured response plus unchanged source; the new real-booking regression reproduces the unknown/known/current-policy behavior.

repair.semantics: Whole journey, session-level pg_advisory_lock/hashtextextended(key,0), reserved physical connection, unlock and release in finally; connection closes in outer finally.
repair.calendar: B10/S4 browser seeds now call createSyntheticBookingCalendar: explicitly synthetic approved 09:00-18:00 every-day input with a synthetic source marker and DB clock_timestamp(), never a wait or backdate.
repair.unknownPolicyScenario: B11 empty/unknown operating-policy fixture is unchanged. Actual booking still rejects the current unknown calendar before and after the explicit synthetic known calendar.
repair.timeouts: Existing 120000 total budgets for B10 review/photo and S4 move from the body to the start of automatic fixture setup, before lock acquisition. B10 HTTP/B11 keep default budgets. No expectation/action timeout, fixture timeout override, retries, force-click or blanket increase.
